verdict.rationale: Graphite provides AI-generated suggestions on the user's own code and PR data inside the product. AI reviews analyze every PR and suggest fixes, and Graphite Chat explains changes, highlights potential issues and diagnoses failing CI checks. However, its separate Insights productivity-metrics feature is never documented as AI-generated, so AI insights are evidenced only within PR review and not across the user's data more broadly. missing for 10: evidence that Insights/productivity analytics are AI-generated or AI-summarized, AI insights beyond individual PR/code review scope, independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the AI suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI reviews analyze every pull request in your repositories, identifying potential issues and suggesting fixes instantly
Ask Graphite to explain what changed in a pull request, highlight potential issues, or provide context about specific code sections.
Diagnose and resolve failing checks directly from your PR page with full context from your CI results.
Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click right from the review page.
